account_evidence_summaries.description: Aggregate coverage and conflict counts describing how well each account is evidenced. Individual observations never leave the device through this type.

account_plan_observations.description: Plan labels carrying only the canonical account reference, provider bounds, and evidence grade. Emails, provider user IDs, conversation and turn IDs, artifact paths, and raw provenance are deliberately absent from this type.

code_change_metrics.description: Privacy-safe numeric code-change metrics. Paths, diffs, source text, tool arguments, and commit messages are deliberately absent from this type.

quota_cycle_contributions.description: Attributed quota-cycle contributions. Local quota records, payloads, plans, credits, and sample counts are deliberately absent from this type.

AccountPlanProjectionV1.description: Privacy-safe device contribution sent to the hosted service.

estimated_api_equivalent_micro_usd.description: Exact estimated cost in millionths of a USD. New producers populate this alongside the legacy cent field so older consumers remain compatible.

provider_reported_micro_usd.description: Exact provider-reported cost in millionths of a USD, when available.

speed.description: Provider-reported inference speed, such as Claude's `standard` or `fast`.

QuotaCycleContributionV1.description: Hosted device contribution for one attributed quota cycle. Omits raw events, paths, source IDs, payloads, plans, credits, slots, fingerprints, and sample counts.

contribution_id.description: Deterministic device contribution ID, not a logical account-cycle ID.

has_schedule_overlap.description: True when this device locally reconstructed another cycle for the same scope whose schedule overlaps this one. Codex weekly cycles start lazily at first use, so a corroborated overlap means the neighbouring cycle was reset early (banked or server-granted), not that the data conflicts.

QuotaDailyEnvelopeV1.description: Timestamped first/last/min/max percentages observed on one UTC day.

QuotaUsageSliceV1.description: Exact usage for a partial UTC day at a cycle or schedule-transition boundary.

latency_ms.description: End-to-end request or turn duration, not time to first token.

latency_source.description: Provenance of latency_ms when the adapter can distinguish it.

time_to_first_token_ms.description: Time from request start until the first visible token arrives.

generated_tps.description: Per-turn generated throughput distribution across tracked turns.

latency_ms.description: Aggregated end-to-end request or turn duration, not TTFT.

overall_generated_tps.description: Overall generated throughput across tracked active time.

overall_visible_tps.description: Overall visible throughput across tracked active time.

visible_tps.description: Per-turn visible throughput distribution across tracked turns.

cache_creation_1h_tokens.description: Anthropic cache writes using the extended one-hour lifetime.

cache_creation_5m_tokens.description: Anthropic cache writes using the default five-minute lifetime.
